cards.answer: Katarina is an assassin/mage who blinks into fights and slashes nearby enemies by picking up Daggers. Recent champion takedowns reduce her ability cooldowns, helping her keep fighting. Her damage includes magic and physical damage, with AD and AP scaling.
cards.counterplay: Keep away from her Daggers and save interrupting crowd control for her ultimate.

cards.answer: Death Lotus channels a flurry of daggers at nearby enemy champions, dealing physical and magic damage, applying on-hit and on-attack effects, and inflicting Grievous Wounds. Cast-inhibiting effects interrupt the channel, and targets do not have to be visible to be hit.
cards.counterplay: Use interrupting crowd control during the channel or move out of range; do not rely on hiding from vision.
